Callout.Name: Detained Shoplifter
Callout.Message: Store staff holding a shoplifter in the office.

Script.Line: I have got a receipt in my bag for all of it.
The security guard grabbed me before I got to the till.
I am not resisting. Look, I am sat down and I am not resisting.

Lines.Approach: They have him in the office and the goods are on the desk. He is not fighting anybody.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
